Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, elevated RDW, and increased inflammatory markers (ferritin, D-dimer, alkaline phosphatase, INR). These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or other acute illness. Liver and renal function are preserved. Close clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
